trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Nothing to do for this one directly — it unlocks the instant the other 54 are finished. Your real target is A Long Road, the 100% completion trophy; when that one pops, the Platinum follows right behind it. Follow the roadmap: story, then the 100% checklist in free roam, then the remaining side strands and miscellaneous trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops at the end of Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1 — just play the opening and it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops when Chapter 1 ends. Play the main missions through to the end of the chapter. One thing to do first, though: Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude happens in this chapter, and it is the only thing here you can miss — do it before you move on.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops when Chapter 2 ends — keep following the main missions and it unlocks at the chapter's close.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops when Chapter 3 ends — keep following the main missions and it unlocks at the chapter's close.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops when Chapter 4 ends — keep following the main missions and it unlocks at the chapter's close. While you are in this chapter, the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… opens the bank vault jobs — a good time to start them.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops when you finish the final story mission in Chapter 5. One of only two Gold trophies, it usually arrives just before the Platinum — once the credits roll, free roam opens and the 100% cleanup starts.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops when you finish the mission Breakfast Run during the campaign. Just stay on the main mission line.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops when you finish the mission The Cartel Heist during the campaign. Just stay on the main mission line.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops when you finish the mission Child's Play during the campaign. Just stay on the main mission line.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops when you finish the mission Headliners during the campaign. Just stay on the main mission line.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops when you finish the mission VCIA Takedown during the campaign. Just stay on the main mission line.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops when you finish the mission Operation Savage Glory during the campaign. Just stay on the main mission line.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The toughest trophy in the game and the true gate to the Platinum. Once the story is done, check Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — work you did during the story already counts. The list is forgiving, about 60% of true completion rather than everything. The big counts: 100 optional tasks, 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults, $250,000 of Marked Bills fenced, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied, 42 of 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 42 of 42 Drone Time Trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Nothing on it can be missed — all of it is doable in free roam after the story. Expect it to take most of the ~200-hour Platinum run.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 different stunts around Leonida — jumps, flips and the rest, each distinct stunt counted once. They come naturally when you drive fast over ramps and jumps; hunt them on purpose on the highways and stunt jumps around Vice City. The 100% list asks for 300 of 397 stunts, so don't stop at 250 — the next 50 count toward A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, pool, mini golf, basketball, drone races and the other map activities. The map marks activity icons — one round of each is all it takes. Do this early, since the same activities come back in bigger numbers on the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Find the ranges around Leonida and work through every challenge; gold needs quick, accurate shooting, so pick a weapon you are comfortable with and replay challenges as often as you like — retries cost nothing. All 42 are also on the 100% checklist, so this counts twice toward the Platinum.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations. The races run at Top Fun venues across the map — win once at every venue. The 100% list also wants all 42 Drone Time Trials done, so run a venue's time trials while you are there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. A repeat win on the same race does not count again, so spread your wins across 20 separate race events. Races are marked on the map — mix street, off-road and water. The 100% list wants 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing after 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, take his challenge, then out-fish him — more fish, or bigger ones, inside the challenge. Fishing spots are marked on the map; steady reeling wins this one, not speed.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Find a cabinet — arcades and some bars around Vice City have them — and play a full game through; any title works. The 100% list later asks you to play all four video games, so remember which ones you have already tried.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is a side-character storyline that opens during the campaign; play his missions in order and the trophy pops at the end of his last one. Side-character finals can't be missed as long as you finish their strands — during the story, or in free roam afterwards.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Play through Kenton's strand — he connects to the treasure sets (5 of 7 are needed for 100%) — and the trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Play through Billy's strand in order; the trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight Stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions show as pink-lettered icons on the map; each strand is a short chain of missions for one stranger. Any eight will do — more than eight exist, so skip the ones you don't like. The progress menu's Strangers & Freaks section tracks them.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Play through Randy's strand in order; the trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Play through Tyrone's strand in order; the trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (10 locations). THE ONE TROPHY YOU CAN MISS: the first meditation is Lucia's, at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she mentions meditating, and choose Accept. That spot is gone after Chapter 1, and nobody has confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe and save manually right after. The other spots are marked meditation locations — travel to them with Jason and Lucia; meditating with both characters at one spot counts twice toward the 18. The final spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. The 100% list only needs 15 of 18, so this trophy asks for three more than A Long Road does.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand sends you after specific unique animals around Leonida; finish one of his hunts and the trophy pops. His full strand — all 15 Target Decks — is also a 100% requirement, so keep hunting after the first one.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish three full Collectible Card sets. Cards turn up all over Leonida — in shops, on the street, in hidden spots. A set is done when you own every card in it; three complete sets pop the trophy. The 100% list wants 15 of 18 sets, so this is only the start of a long collection — log locations in the WAiNK app as you go.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app on your phone and scan unfamiliar vehicles, landmarks and locations whenever the prompt appears — it records the spot. Scan early and often during the story: 100 scans is also a 100% requirement, and scanning while you travel saves hours of backtracking.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 Challenges. Challenges are short objectives across the map and activities — stunt, combat, driving and exploration challenges all count. They finish on their own while you play; the Challenges menu shows which ones are close. The 100% list wants 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 and skip the 10 hardest.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Reach four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears — alleys, the subway or open water break the search. It is easier in a quieter part of the map, away from police spawns.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner next to you, hold up a shop, then hit a second and a third right away while the wanted level stays up — don't let the heat drop between robberies. Pick three shops close together on one street and plan your escape before the first one.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Get in or scan 100 different vehicle models — the WAiNK app records new models as you meet them. Drive everything you see during the story; the 100% list wants 200 of 277 base models, so this is the first half of a longer scan.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Switch Combat Focus on during a firefight with at least five enemies in view and drop five of them before it ends. Pick a crowded shootout — a gang operation or a police chase — and save it for a moment when the enemies are bunched together.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a passenger aircraft that is taxiing out for takeoff and get it into the air. Airport security is heavy, so come prepared and move fast once you are on the runway.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos show up at military sites and during high wanted levels; steal one, then use its cannon in a fight — blowing up vehicles or taking down enemies with it counts. Expect a heavy military response once you are inside.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, slip in quietly, and take the goods without tripping an alarm or being seen by staff or cameras — no witnesses, no alarm. Go at a quiet hour and get out before anyone notices.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the big jobs — crack the vault, take the cash and lose the pursuit, five times. The 100% list wants all eight vaults, so keep the crew together for the last three; the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 unlocks the vault jobs.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it — ram it or block it — crack it open, take the cash, then lose the police. Trucks run on highways and near banks; hit one away from a police station for an easier getaway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Uncover every region of the map — drive, fly or sail through each area until nothing is fogged. It unlocks on its own if you travel for the other trophies, but check the map for fogged corners (islands and the far north) and sweep them on purpose.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Every gang runs illegal operations marked on the map; hit at least one operation for each of the nine gangs. Work through them during the story — gang operations also feed the 100% list, which wants all 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. The exact trigger is still being pinned down by the guide sites — if it doesn't pop at the first bar, try the beachfront bars at different times of day and check the linked sources for updates.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's window and out the other side. Which showroom and the exact method are still being confirmed by the guide sites — check the linked sources for the verified method once it is pinned down.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. At the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, steal the three key valuables and get out. Case the alley first, take all three items, and leave before security locks the place down.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Build Strength for both characters — gym workouts, melee and heavy lifting raise it — until both reach the maximum. The current guide reading ties this trophy to maxed Strength; the description is vague on purpose and the method is still being confirmed, so check the linked sources if it doesn't pop.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. Your Criminal Profile counts everything shady you do — robberies, thefts, getaways and the like. Play the way the game wants you to: keep doing criminal acts and the counter climbs. It is a volume trophy; it will land during the 100% grind without any special effort.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A story trophy with a deliberately vague description — the guide sites have not confirmed how it unlocks yet. It seems to trigger at a story moment (the description hints at a second attempt working out), so play through the campaign and it should pop on its own. Check the linked sources for the confirmed trigger once the guides pin it down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A story trophy with a deliberately vague description — the guide sites have not confirmed how it unlocks yet. The title points at an unusual encounter somewhere in Leonida; play the story, explore, and check the linked sources once the guides confirm the trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Take out a target with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar, not a gun. The precise method is still being confirmed by the guide sites; check the linked sources for the exact setup once it is verified.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; take them to a contact who launders them and keep going until $250,000 has passed through. This is also a 100% requirement, so the laundering you do for the checklist counts here too.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food, car mods — anything in any shop counts toward the total. Most of it goes on its own on gear and vehicles; if you are short at the end, spend the rest on expensive clothing or weapon attachments.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every purchasable garage on the map — eight in total. They are marked as properties for sale; you will need serious cash, so leave this until after the big story payouts and vault jobs.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register vehicles you own or find — ten registrations pop the trophy. Register cars as you get them during the story and it finishes itself.
